entries.title: About Maharaja Institute of Technology Mysore (MITM)
question_examples: mit mysore kahan hai aur kab bana
I am a parent wanting to know about this institution
How big is the MIT Mysore campus?
tell me about maharaja education trust
entries.answer_short: Maharaja Institute of Technology Mysore (MITM) was established in 2007 by the Maharaja Education Trust (MET). It is set on an 11-acre green campus at Belawadi, Srirangapatna Taluk, near Mysore.
entries.answer_detail: Maharaja Institute of Technology Mysore (MITM) was founded in 2007 under the auspices of the Maharaja Education Trust (MET), Mysore. The institution spans an 11-acre campus at Belawadi, Srirangapatna Taluk (approximately 3 km behind K.R. Mills, off the Mysore-Bangalore corridor). The college is dedicated to providing quality technical education and research across engineering, management, computer applications, and pharmaceutical sciences.

entries.title: Vision & Mission of MIT Mysore
question_examples: What is the vision and mission of MIT Mysore?
mit mysore ka vision aur mission kya hai
I'm evaluating institutions based on academic vision and philosophy
What is the educational mission of Maharaja Institute of Technology?
entries.answer_short: MIT Mysore's vision is to be a premier center of technical education and research, developing socially conscious and technically competent professionals.
entries.answer_detail:
Vision & Mission:
* **Vision**: To be recognized as a premier technical education institution fostering innovation, ethical values, and research excellence.
* **Mission**:
  - Provide outcome-based education through state-of-the-art infrastructure and student-centered teaching methodologies.
  - Encourage continuous industry-academia interaction, research, and entrepreneurship.
  - Inculcate ethical integrity, environmental awareness, and societal responsibility among students.

entries.title: Affiliation, Approvals and Accreditations
question_examples: Is MIT Mysore affiliated to VTU?
college autonomous aa athava vtu na
kya mit mysore vtu se affiliated hai
I'm a visitor verifying the college accreditations
difference between autonomous and vtu status here
entries.answer_short: MIT Mysore is approved by AICTE New Delhi, recognized by the Government of Karnataka, and permanently affiliated to Visvesvaraya Technological University (VTU), Belagavi. It holds accreditations from NAAC and NBA.
entries.answer_detail:
MIT Mysore operates under the following official accreditations and recognitions:
* **Affiliation**: Visvesvaraya Technological University (VTU), Belagavi, Karnataka.
* **Approval**: All India Council for Technical Education (AICTE), New Delhi.
* **Government Recognition**: Recognized by the Department of Technical Education, Government of Karnataka.
* **Quality Accreditations**: Accredited by the National Assessment and Accreditation Council (NAAC), National Board of Accreditation (NBA), and ISO certified.

entries.title: How to Reach MIT Mysore (Bus, Train, Directions)
question_examples: I am a visitor arriving at Mysore Junction railway station
how far is the college from suburban bus stand?
entries.answer_short: MIT Mysore is located at Belawadi, about 15 km from Mysore Railway Station and Suburb Bus Stand. It is reachable via city buses toward Belawadi/K.R. Mills, college buses, autos, or cabs.
entries.answer_detail:
Directions to Reach MIT Mysore:
* **From Mysore City Railway Station (~15 km)**: Take a taxi, auto, or city bus from city bus stand toward K.R. Mills / Belawadi.
* **From Mysore Suburb Bus Stand (~16 km)**: Regular KSRTC and city buses ply toward Mandya/Srirangapatna. Disembark at K.R. Mills stop and take an auto (approx 3 km) to campus.
* **College Bus Service**: MIT Mysore runs a dedicated fleet of over 100 buses across Mysore, Mandya, Srirangapatna, and surrounding towns with direct campus drop-off.
* **Landmark**: Situated 3 km behind K.R. Mills off the Mysore-Bangalore road.

entries.answer_detail:
Postgraduate & Allied Campus Programs:

* **MCA (Master of Computer Applications)**: 2 Years / 4 Semesters, featuring MCA LH 1-4 and MCA Lab 1.

* **Faculty of Pharmaceutical Sciences**: Offers pharmacy and health programs with pharmaceutical analysis, pharmacology, and pharmaceutics research laboratories.

entries.title: Course Eligibility Criteria (B.E., MBA, MCA, BCA)
question_examples: What is the eligibility criteria for engineering and PG courses?
admission ke liye kitna percentage chahiye
I am a PUC student with 50% in PCM, am I eligible for admission?
What qualification is required for MCA lateral or regular entry?
entries.answer_short: For B.E., candidates must have passed 10+2 / 2nd PUC with Physics & Math plus Chemistry/Bio/CS with minimum 45% marks (40% for Karnataka SC/ST/OBC). For MCA/MBA, a relevant Bachelor's degree with 50% is required.
entries.answer_detail:
Eligibility Guidelines:
* **B.E. Programs**: Passed 10+2 / 2nd PUC or equivalent with Physics and Mathematics as compulsory subjects, along with Chemistry / Biology / Computer Science. Minimum 45% aggregate in optional subjects (40% for Karnataka SC, ST, and OBC candidates).
* **MBA**: Recognized Bachelor's degree of minimum 3 years duration with at least 50% marks aggregate (45% for reserved categories) and a valid PGCET/KMAT score.
* **MCA**: Recognized BCA / B.Sc. (Computer Science/IT) or equivalent degree with mathematics at 10+2 or degree level, with at least 50% marks.
* **B.E. Lateral Entry**: Diploma or B.Sc. with minimum 45% marks eligible for direct 2nd-year admission via DCET.

entries.title: Admission Process & Entrance Exams (KCET, COMEDK, PGCET)
aliases: how to get admission in mitm
question_examples: How to get admission into MIT Mysore?
mit mysore me admission kaise le
I'm a parent inquiring about B.E. admission through KCET
what entrance exams are accepted for MBA and MCA?
entries.answer_short: Admissions to B.E. are through KCET (KEA) and COMEDK counselling, plus Management Quota. For MBA/MCA, admissions are conducted via PGCET and KMAT.
entries.answer_detail:
Admission Routes for MIT Mysore:
* **B.E. Programs**: Qualified candidates must participate in Karnataka Examinations Authority (KEA - KCET) or COMEDK counselling. A quota of seats is also available under Management.
* **MBA & MCA Programs**: Admissions through Karnataka PGCET or national KMAT entrance exams followed by centralized counselling.
* **Eligibility for B.E.**: Pass in 10+2 / PUC with Physics & Mathematics along with Chemistry/Bio/CS with minimum 45% marks (40% for Karnataka SC/ST/OBC).
* **Office**: Admissions desk is situated near Point A (Admission Staircase) on the ground floor of the Administrative block.

entries.title: Documents Required for College Admission
question_examples: What documents are required for admission reporting?
admission ke liye kaunse documents chahiye
I'm a first-year student reporting to the college office today
do non-Karnataka students need migration certificate?
entries.answer_short: You need 10th & 12th marks cards, KEA/COMEDK allotment order, Transfer Certificate, Conduct Certificate, Caste/Income certificates (if applicable), Migration certificate (for non-Karnataka), and passport photos.
entries.answer_detail:
Document Checklist for Physical Reporting:
1. KEA / COMEDK Admission Allotment Order and Fee Receipt (Original + 3 copies).
2. 10th / SSLC Marks Card (Original + 3 copies).
3. 12th / 2nd PUC Marks Card (Original + 3 copies).
4. Transfer Certificate (TC) from previous institution.
5. Conduct / Study Certificate (minimum 7 years for Karnataka candidates).
6. Caste and Income Certificate (if claiming reservation/scholarship).
7. Migration Certificate (for students coming from outside Karnataka / non-PUC boards).
8. Recent passport-size photographs (5 copies).
9. Aadhaar card photocopy.

entries.title: Fee Structure & Available Scholarships (SSP, Vidyasiri, NSP)
question_examples: What is the fee structure and scholarship details?
how much is the fees for cse
mit mysore ki fees kitni hai
I am a parent asking for the annual tuition fee breakdown
What government scholarships can Karnataka students apply for?
entries.answer_short: KCET and COMEDK fees are set as per annual government notifications. Karnataka students can apply for Post-Matric SSP, Vidyasiri, and National Scholarships (NSP) through the college accounts office.
entries.answer_detail:
Fee Structure & Scholarships Guidance:
* **Government / KCET Quota**: Annual tuition and university fees are governed by the Karnataka Examinations Authority (KEA) fee regulation.
* **COMEDK & Management Quota**: Prescribed annually per branch. For exact verified figures, please visit the college accounts section or contact office.
* **Scholarships Available**:
  - State Scholarship Portal (SSP Karnataka) for SC/ST/OBC/Minority students.
  - Vidyasiri (E-Pass) food and accommodation support.
  - National Scholarship Portal (NSP) for merit and minority schemes.
* **Accounts Section**: Ground floor near Point A. Fees can be paid via online portal, RTGS/NEFT, or DD drawn in favor of Principal, Maharaja Institute of Technology Mysore.

entries.title: Fee Payment Modes & Refund Policy
question_examples: How to pay college fees and what is the refund policy?
I'm a parent needing the official account details for RTGS / NEFT fee transfer
What is the AICTE refund norm if admission is withdrawn?
entries.answer_short: Fees can be paid online via net banking, RTGS/NEFT, or Demand Draft (DD) in favor of Principal, Maharaja Institute of Technology Mysore. Refunds follow official AICTE / KEA cancellation norms.
entries.answer_detail:
Payment & Cancellation Policy:
* **Payment Modes Accepted**:
  - Demand Draft (DD) drawn in favor of 'Principal, Maharaja Institute of Technology Mysore' payable at Mysore.
  - RTGS / NEFT transfer into official college bank account (challan available at Accounts Counter).
  - Online payment portal.
* **Refund Policy**: Follows standard AICTE and Karnataka Higher Education Department regulations. Complete refunds with nominal deduction apply if cancelled before the notified last admission date.

entries.title: VTU Academic Regulations, Attendance & Examinations
question_examples: What is the attendance rule and internal exam pattern?
I'm a first-year student wanting to know how CIE internals are scored
What happens if attendance is below 75%?
entries.answer_short: VTU mandates a minimum of 75% attendance in each subject to be eligible for examinations. Three Continuous Internal Evaluation (CIE) tests are held per semester.
entries.answer_detail:
VTU Academic Regulations:
* **Attendance Mandate**: Minimum 75% attendance in both theory and practicals is compulsory. Up to 10% condonation is allowed by the Principal only on verified medical grounds.
* **Continuous Internal Evaluation (CIE)**: Conducted 3 times per semester. Marks are awarded based on test scores, assignments, quizzes, and lab performance.
* **Semester End Examination (SEE)**: University examinations conducted at the end of each semester under VTU guidelines.
* **Results**: Officially published on results.vtu.ac.in.

I'm a new student asking about the morning assembly and lecture periods
What time do evening practical sessions finish?
entries.answer_short: Classes run from 9:00 AM to 4:45 PM Monday through Friday, with a lunch break from 1:15 PM to 2:00 PM. Saturdays typically follow half-day schedules.
entries.answer_detail:
Daily Academic Schedule:
* **Morning Sessions**: 9:00 AM to 1:15 PM (Four 55-minute lecture periods).
* **Lunch Break**: 1:15 PM to 2:00 PM.
* **Afternoon Sessions**: 2:00 PM to 4:45 PM (Practical lab sessions, project work, and tutorials).
* **Bus Departure**: Buses depart campus at 4:50 PM.
* **Academic Calendar**: Odd semesters span September to January; Even semesters span February to July.

entries.title: Training & Placement Cell (Recruiters, Packages & ETSDP)
question_examples: What are the placement statistics, packages, and recruiters?
placement kaisa hai aur kitna package milta hai
I am a prospective student asking about career and placement opportunities
Which IT companies visit for campus placement drives?
entries.answer_short: MIT Mysore's Placement Cell conducts regular training under ETSDP. The average package is around 4 LPA, with top offers reaching 15 to 19 LPA from recruiters like Infosys, TCS, and Wipro.
entries.answer_detail:
Training & Placement Cell Information:
* **Training Program (ETSDP)**: Entrepreneur and Technical Skills Development Program provides continuous training in coding aptitude, data structures, soft skills, and mock interviews starting from early semesters.
* **Top Recruiters**: Infosys, TCS, Wipro, Cognizant, Mindtree, Tech Mahindra, Capgemini, SLK Software, and core engineering enterprises.
* **Packages**: Average packages typically range between 3.8 to 5 LPA, with dream offers up to 15 to 19 LPA in recent cycles.
* **Placement Office**: Located on the first floor near the Administrative Block.

entries.title: Placement Registration & Eligibility Criteria
aliases: how to register for campus placements
question_examples: What is the eligibility criteria to register for campus placements?
how to register for placement cell
placement ke liye kitna cgpa chahiye
I am a pre-final year student wanting to register with the placement cell
What are the attendance criteria for placement training sessions?
entries.answer_short: Students with 60% or 6.5+ CGPA and no active backlogs are eligible for most Tier-1 drives. Mandatory attendance in ETSDP training modules is required to sit for campus drives.
entries.answer_detail:
Placement Eligibility Guidelines:
* **Academic Cut-off**: Most top recruiters mandate minimum 60% (or 6.5 CGPA) throughout 10th, 12th, and B.E. semesters.
* **Backlog Policy**: No active backlogs at the time of appearing for recruitment drives.
* **Training Attendance**: 85%+ attendance in ETSDP soft-skill and aptitude bootcamps is compulsory.
* **Registration**: Pre-final year students register with the Placement Cell at the start of the 6th/7th semester.

entries.title: Student Life, Clubs, Fests & Anti-Ragging Committee
question_examples: What clubs, fests, and student activities happen at MIT Mysore?
I am a new student interested in technical hackathons and cultural clubs
Who do I contact regarding the Anti-Ragging Committee?
entries.answer_short: MIT Mysore hosts annual fests like Mahotsav, technical hackathons, cultural events, sports meets, and an active NSS unit. The college maintains a strict zero-tolerance anti-ragging policy.
entries.answer_detail:
Student Life & Extracurricular Activities:
* **Flagship Fest (Mahotsav)**: Annual inter-collegiate cultural and technical fest featuring music, dance, coding hackathons, and literary competitions.
* **Clubs**: Technical societies (Coding, Robotics, Web development), Cultural forum, Literary club, Photography and Media club.
* **NSS Unit**: Regular social community service, tree planting, and voluntary blood donation camps.
* **Anti-Ragging Committee**: Headed by the Principal and senior faculty with zero-tolerance enforcement under Supreme Court and UGC guidelines.

entries.title: Student ID Card & KSRTC Bus Pass Process
aliases: how to get college id card
how to get ksrtc bus pass
question_examples: How do I get my student ID card or KSRTC bus pass attested?
ksrtc bus pass ge sign elli hakthare
id card aur bus pass kaise banaye
I lost my college ID card, what is the procedure to get a duplicate?
Where in the administrative office do I get my Seva Sindhu KSRTC pass signed?
entries.answer_short: Official ID cards are issued upon admission at the Administrative Office. For KSRTC bus passes, apply via Seva Sindhu portal and submit the verification slip at the college counter for seal and signature.
entries.answer_detail:
ID Card & KSRTC Pass Steps:
* **ID Card**: Issued during first-year induction. Wear visibly at all times with the official lanyard. For duplicates, submit an application with fee receipt at the Administrative Counter.
* **KSRTC Student Pass**: Register online on Seva Sindhu portal (Karnataka Gov), print the acknowledgment, get it stamped and signed by the designated college officer at the Admin Counter, and collect your smart card at the nearest KSRTC depot.

entries.title: Campus Discipline, Dress Code & Mobile Phone Policy
question_examples: What are the campus rules on dress code, mobile phones, and ID cards?
I'm a new student asking about the mandatory uniform and ID card policy
What is the policy for visitors entering the campus?
entries.answer_short: Students must wear formal attire, mandatory lab aprons during practicals, and display their official ID card with lanyard at all times. Mobile phone usage is prohibited inside classrooms.
entries.answer_detail:
College Code of Conduct & Policies:
* **Dress Code**: Neat, modest formal attire is compulsory. Lab uniforms/aprons must be worn during all workshop and laboratory sessions.
* **ID Card**: Official college ID cards with lanyards must be visibly displayed at all times on campus premises.
* **Mobile Phone Usage**: Restricted to designated open spaces. Use of mobile phones inside classrooms, lecture halls, and laboratories is strictly prohibited.
* **Discipline**: Zero tolerance for ragging, smoking, or substance abuse.

entries.title: Official Notices, Circulars & Event Boards
question_examples: Where are the official college circulars and notices published?

Official Information & Circular Channels:
* **Website Notice Board**: Check the official announcements section at mitmysore.in for administrative, exam, and holiday notifications.
* **Physical Notice Boards**: Prominently located on the ground floor foyer near Point A (Admission Staircase) and on individual departmental floors.
* **University Circulars**: Official VTU notifications are available directly on vtu.ac.in.

entries.title: How to Use MITM Navigo Corridor Wayfinding
question_examples: How do I use MITM Navigo to find classrooms and labs?
how to share a room link
I am a visitor trying to find my way to a specific room
What can the Ask Navigo chatbot do?
entries.answer_short: MITM Navigo provides 1-tap indoor visual navigation. Select your academic block, type or select any room number, and follow step-by-step corridor photographs to your destination.
entries.answer_detail:
How to Use MITM Navigo:
1. **Select College or Block**: On the home portal, choose between Engineering, MBA, MCA, BCA, or Pharmacy.
2. **Search or Select Room**: Type a room number (e.g., '117', '205', 'MCA Lab 1') in the search bar or pick from the floor grid.
3. **Visual Corridor Walkthrough**: Follow step-by-step corridor photos showing every doorway and turn from the entrance staircase to the destination.
4. **WhatsApp Sharing**: Tap the WhatsApp button to share the exact corridor route with friends or visitors.
5. **Ask Navigo Chatbot**: Click the blue 'Ask Navigo' button anytime for instant answers.

entries.title: First Day Guide for Newly Admitted Students
aliases: what to do on first day
question_examples: What should a first-year student do on their first day at MIT Mysore?
I'm a first-year student arriving on campus for the first time
What should I bring on orientation day?
entries.answer_short: On your first day, arrive by 8:45 AM, report to the Administrative Block foyer near Point A for verification, collect your ID card / bus pass, and proceed to the orientation hall.
entries.answer_detail:
First Day Campus Checklist for Freshers:
1. **Arrival**: Reach campus by 8:45 AM via college bus or city transit.
2. **Reporting**: Head directly to the Administrative Block foyer near Point A (Admission Staircase).
3. **Documents**: Carry original allotment order, fees challan, and 10th/12th marks cards.
4. **Orientation**: Follow staff signs to the Belaku Auditorium or departmental lecture hall for the inaugural induction program.
5. **Bus Pass & ID**: Get your college ID card lanyard and bus pass at the administrative desk.
6. **Dress Code**: Wear neat formal attire with shoes.

entries.title: Visitor & Parent Campus Guide
question_examples: What is the visitor and parent guide for campus visits?
I am a parent visiting for admission enquiry with my vehicle
Where can visitors wait and have refreshments?
entries.answer_short: Visitors should register at the main security gate, park at the designated vehicle lot, and proceed to the Administrative Foyer near Point A for admissions or principal appointments.
entries.answer_detail:
Visitor & Parent Information:
* **Security Gate**: Register your vehicle and obtain a visitor pass at the main campus entrance gate.
* **Parking**: Ample dedicated parking space for four-wheelers and two-wheelers right inside the main gate.
* **Administrative & Principal Office**: Enter the Engineering Academic Block via Point A (Main Entrance); the Principal's chamber and reception are on the first level.
* **Waiting & Refreshments**: Comfortable guest lounge in the administrative foyer; the campus canteen is open 8:00 AM – 6:00 PM for refreshments.

entries.title: Navigo Demo Mode (Testing & Mock Data)
question_examples: How do I enable demo mode in Ask Navigo?
I am a developer wanting to test UI cards with sample values
entries.answer_short: Type '/demo' in the chat to toggle Demo Mode on or off. In Demo Mode, unverified fields display clearly labeled sample values like 'Room 000 (sample)' for UI testing.
entries.answer_detail:
Demo Mode Features:
* **Activation**: Type `/demo` in the chat input and hit enter.
* **Behavior**: Fills any unverified facts with visibly marked `[SAMPLE - DEMO MODE]` labels so you can test cards and buttons.
* **Safety**: Sample mock data is strictly hidden during standard student and visitor mode.
